name: Dromaar Company

items.name: Bola Hurl
items.text: The dromaars draw bolas and toss them in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in this area takes 3d6 nonlethal bludgeoning damage (DC 21 basic Reflex save save). A creature who fails this saving throw is also knocked Prone.

items.name: Charge the Fallen
items.text: The dromaar company Strides up to twice, sweeping with their axes. They deal 2d8+5 slashing damage (DC 21 basic Reflex save save) to each enemy in a 5-foot emanation at the end of their movement. This damage increases by 5 if the target is Prone.

items.name: Disciplined Strikes
items.text:
1 to 3

Frequency once per round

---
Effect The dromaars coordinate melee attacks with their axes against all enemies in a 5-foot emanation (DC 21 basic Reflex save save). The damage depends on the number of actions.

1 1d8 slashing damage

2 2d8+5 slashing damage

3 2d8+10 slashing damage

text: Numerous dromaar mercenary companies operate in and around Belkzen, providing their strength at arms to any hold that requests their services. These disciplined warriors march confidently into battle, bringing their axes to bear against all who stand in their way.
